import json
from service import get_score

# Mock compute function to track calls
def mock_compute(user_id, job_id, profile_version):
    return f"score_{user_id}_{job_id}_{profile_version}"

# Test cache behavior
def test_cache_respects_profile_changes():
    store = {}
    user_id = "user1"
    job_id = "job1"
    
    # First call: cache miss, compute called
    assert get_score(store, user_id, job_id, "v1", lambda: mock_compute(user_id, job_id, "v1")) == "score_user1_job1_v1"
    
    # Second call with same profile: cache hit, compute not called
    assert get_score(store, user_id, job_id, "v1", lambda: mock_compute(user_id, job_id, "v1")) == "score_user1_job1_v1"
    
    # Third call with different profile: cache miss, compute called
    assert get_score(store, user_id, job_id, "v2", lambda: mock_compute(user_id, job_id, "v2")) == "score_user1_job1_v2"
    
    # Fourth call with same profile again: cache hit, compute not called
    assert get_score(store, user_id, job_id, "v2", lambda: mock_compute(user_id, job_id, "v2")) == "score_user1_job1_v2"

# Test cache respects user_id and job_id

def test_cache_respects_user_and_job():
    store = {}
    
    # Different user_id, same job_id, same profile
    assert get_score(store, "user1", "job1", "v1", lambda: mock_compute("user1", "job1", "v1")) == "score_user1_job1_v1"
    assert get_score(store, "user2", "job1", "v1", lambda: mock_compute("user2", "job1", "v1")) == "score_user2_job1_v1"
    
    # Same user_id, different job_id, same profile
    assert get_score(store, "user1", "job2", "v1", lambda: mock_compute("user1", "job2", "v1")) == "score_user1_job2_v1"
    
    # Different user_id, different job_id, different profile
    assert get_score(store, "user2", "job2", "v2", lambda: mock_compute("user2", "job2", "v2")) == "score_user2_job2_v2"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_cache_respects_profile_changes()
    test_cache_respects_user_and_job()
